entities.summary: Briahna Joy Gray is an American political commentator, lawyer, and political consultant. After writing for The Intercept in 2018 she started her political career as the National Press Secretary for the Bernie Sanders 2020 presidential campaign. She was the co-host of The Hill's web program Rising from September 2022 to June 7, 2024, when she was fired after a tense interview with the sister of one of the Israeli hostages held by Hamas. She is the host of the Bad Faith podcast.
